listings.title: PET Felt
listings.intro: Elevate your spaces with PET felt acoustic solutions that seamlessly blend exceptional sound management with environmental responsibility. Crafted from 100% PET plastic containing at least 60% post-consumer content, each installation diverts hundreds of plastic bottles from landfills without compromising on performance or design flexibility. The material’s dense, fibrous structure effectively absorbs sound waves across a broad frequency spectrum, dramatically reducing reverberation in busy environments. Available in a rich palette of colors and textures, PET felt empowers architects and designers to create visually striking acoustic treatments while supporting sustainability goals through documented environmental credentials—turning yesterday’s beverages into today’s conversation-friendly environments, one bottle at a time.

listings.title: Silk Metal
listings.intro: Transform spaces with MATERIAL LOGIQ’s revolutionary Silk Metal—an acoustic innovation that delivers superior sound absorption without sacrificing aesthetic elegance. Unlike traditional perforated metal systems that require visible holes and bulky acoustic backings, this sophisticated material achieves exceptional acoustic performance through microscopic perforations combined with a strategic air gap. The result is a visually smooth, uniform surface available in multiple finishes including vibrant colors and realistic wood grain textures. For architects and designers seeking the perfect balance of form and function, Silk Metal offers a sustainable solution with unlimited recyclability, contributing to LEED certification while providing the clean, contemporary aesthetic that sophisticated projects demand—proving that sometimes the smallest holes make the biggest sound difference.
